\]

\[
1815 = 3 \times 605 = 3 \times 5 \times 121 = 3 \times 5 \times 11^2
\]

So,

\[
32670 = 2 \times 3^3 \times 5 \times 11^2
\]

\[
32670 = 3^2 \times 11^2 \times (2 \times 3 \times 5)
\]

\[
32670 = (33)^2 \times 30
\]

Therefore,

\[
\sqrt{32670} = \sqrt{(33)^2 \times 30} = 33\sqrt{30}
\]

The answer is \(33\sqrt{30}\).
